title: Find XOR Sum of All Pairs Bitwise AND
goal: Compute the XOR of every pairwise bitwise AND between two arrays.
strategy: Bitwise AND distributes over XOR. Reduce each array independently, then AND the two totals instead of enumerating the cross product.
